about: check-size.mts --budgets: gzip bytes the browser downloads, per class, from dist/ after npm run build. JS is measured with Vite's 8-character chunk hashes replaced by a fixed string, so renaming a chunk does not move the totals. A size over its budget fails; a size more than 5% under fails until the budget is lowered, so budgets only go down. Reset 2026-11-06 at 5e78c96 plus #211 to the hash-stable measure plus 25 B (entry 33145, boot 1166495, workers 2565597, lazy 3048380); workers and lazy dropped by the shared POI data chunk (#211). 2026-11-06, #207 (?ktx2=etc1s, measured at its merge with 2465464): boot 1166520 to 1166546 (measured 1166536: the ktx2 flag becomes a text flag and assets.ts gates the lazy import on its two values), workers 2565622 to 2565676 (measured 2565666: the workers bundle client/src/flags.ts, whose ktx2 entry grows), lazy 3048405 to 3048451 (measured 3048441: the etc1s branch in the ktx2-tex chunk). Each is the measure plus 10 B. Then lazy raised from 3048451 to 3048789 (measured 3048779, +338 B over main's 3048441), an exception the Captain approved for a player-facing fix in lazy code: the client re-traces a predicted hit past the server's rewind cap against the pose at the cap so it shows no marker the server will take back (ClientMatch.lateVerdict, #222). Raised for #223 (the title draws its kong through a half-float target and one screen quad, so it reuses the match programs: 27 fewer compiles before the first key-art frame, Safari Level B ready to first key-art 2447 to 587 ms) to its measure at its merge with bd62825 plus 10 B: lazy 3048789 to 3048969 (measured 3048959, +180 B over main's 3048779); boot fits (measured 1166537). Then entry 33170 to 33217 (measured 33207, +62 B over main's 33145) and boot 1166546 to 1166609 (measured 1166599, +62 B over main's 1166537), each the measure plus 10 B, an exception the Captain approved for a context-restore correctness fix: engine.contextLost also reads gl.isContextLost(), and the engine skips initTexture and warmDraw while the context is lost (#214). Raised for RAY-186 (#235: the display refresh estimate reads rAF timestamps through client/src/engine/refresh.ts, so a GPU-bound match no longer reads as a 30 Hz screen) to its measure at its merge with 87215ac plus 10 B: entry 33217 to 33252 (measured 33242, +35 B over main's 33207), boot 1166609 to 1166643 (measured 1166633, +34 B over main's 1166599). Then lazy raised from 3048969 to 3049232 (measured 3049222 with the change, 3048959 without, at 72630e3): the online link's binary path goes through one Transport (shared/net/transport.ts) with per-channel counters, the base the WebTransport transport plugs into (#224, RAY-184). 2026-11-06, #169 (geofree restore, measured at its merge with ea1c38b): entry 33252 to 33304 (measured 33294: the stream build queue in main.ts), boot 1166643 to 1166746 (measured 1166736), lazy 3049232 down to 3048726 (measured 3048716): the change moves about 500 B out of lazy, so the three budgets together go down by 351 B. Each is the measure plus 10 B.
